title: The Empty Crate
scene: At 9:40 AM, the warehouse crate was emptied. The loading bay was shut during the audit from 9:20 to 10:00.

suspects.name: Elsie Pike
suspects.testimony: I was checking inventory at 9:40, aisle four.
suspects.alibiProof: The inventory sheet shows Elsie's initials at 9:38.

suspects.name: Frank Vale
suspects.alibiProof: The forklift sensor shows Frank moving at 9:39.

suspects.name: Greta Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the loading bay at 9:40, counting crates.
suspects.contradiction: The bay was shut for the audit, and packing tape was on Greta's gloves.

suspects.name: Hank Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the gate at 9:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The gate camera shows Hank at 9:37 and 9:45.
